Work on the engineering of custom-built superyachts Are you a Naval Architect or Marine Engineer based in Portugal and ready to take the next step in your international career? Supporting stability, weight control, structural design and construction-related calculations. Translating design concepts into technically feasible and buildable solutions. Preparing, reviewing and improving technical drawings, calculations and documentation. Coordinating with engineering teams, production, suppliers, classification societies and project stakeholders. Supporting the integration of systems, equipment, interiors and exterior elements into the overall yacht design. Identifying technical risks and proposing practical solutions. Ensuring that designs meet quality, safety, classification and production requirements. Supporting production teams during construction and resolving technical questions. Depending on your experience, the role can be more focused on basic engineering, detailed engineering, structural engineering, outfitting or technical

coordination. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the relocation process. A career opportunity in one of the most respected yacht-building regions in the world. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for candidates with a background in naval architecture, marine engineering, shipbuilding or complex mechanical engineering. You have: A technical degree such as Licenciatura or Mestrado in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Shipbuilding or a related field. Experience in shipbuilding, yacht building, marine engineering, offshore, naval design or complex technical engineering. Good understanding of ship design, construction principles and technical integration. Experience with 2D and/or 3D engineering software. Experience with software such as AutoCAD, Rhino, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Inventor, Maxsurf, NAPA, ShipConstructor, Cadmatic or similar tools is relevant. Knowledge of stability, structures, weight control, hull design, outfitting or classification rules is a strong advantage. The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and engineering documentation. Strong problem-solving skills and a practical engineering mindset. Are you an Exterior Engineer, CAD Engineer or Product Design Engineer based in Portugal and ready to work on unique, high-end technical projects? Xelvin is looking for an engineer who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and contribute to the exterior design and engineering of luxury superyachts. In this role, you will translate design ideas and customer requirements into smart, manufacturable and high-quality technical solutions. You will work on exterior elements such as railings, sliding door systems, sunshade systems, masts, decorative elements, exterior panels and other visible parts of the yacht. This role combines technical engineering, design sensitivity and practical manufacturability. The exterior of a superyacht must not only function perfectly, but also look flawless. What you will do As an Exterior Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. You will work closely with project engineers, architects, production teams and external partners. Your responsibilities include: Creating and developing 3D models for exterior yacht components. Translating design concepts into practical and manufacturable solutions. Engineering exterior parts such as railings, doors, sunshade systems, panels, masts and decorative elements. Checking technical feasibility, quality, cost efficiency and production requirements. Working with other disciplines to make sure exterior systems fit with the overall yacht design. Supporting production and suppliers with clear technical information. Identifying technical risks and proposing smart improvements. Contributing ideas to improve quality, efficiency and manufacturability. Monitoring the technical consistency of your scope within the project. You will work on custom-built projects where every detail must match the overall design and quality standard. What Xelvin offers you A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €5,500, depending on experience.

Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the full relocation process. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for engineers with experience in product design, industrial design, shipbuilding, metalwork, exterior systems or high-end technical engineering.
